title: Getting Started with betterbiplot
text: default, bb_biplot() matches base R biplot() scaling (scale = 1, correlation biplot). Use scale = 0 distance biplot (required drawing circle equilibrium contribution), scale = 0.5 symmetric biplot:
code: old_par <- par(mfrow = c(1, 3), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 2)) bb_biplot(p, scale = 0, group = gr, main = "scale = 0 (sites)") bb_biplot(p, scale = 0.5, group = gr, main = "scale = 0.5 (symmetric)") bb_biplot(p, scale = 1, group = gr, main = "scale = 1 (variables)") par(old_par)

title: Getting Started with betterbiplot
text: three grouping factors can mapped colour (group), symbol (group2), symbol size (group3). Existing factor levels() preserved plot styling legend order, col accepts grDevices::palette.pals() grDevices::hcl.pals() palette name ("Okabe-Ito" "Viridis"):
code: set.seed(42) gr_ord <- factor(iris$Species, levels = c("virginica", "versicolor", "setosa")) gr2 <- factor(sample(c("A", "B"), nrow(iris), replace = TRUE)) gr3 <- factor(sample(c("low", "med", "high"), nrow(iris), replace = TRUE),               levels = c("low", "med", "high"))  bb_biplot(   p, scale = 0,   group = gr_ord, group2 = gr2, group3 = gr3,   col = "Okabe-Ito", alpha = 0.75,   legend = TRUE, leg.args = list(title = c("Species", "Treatment", "Size")) )

what: 3. Ellipses, Convex Hulls, Centroids & Spider Lines
title: Getting Started with betterbiplot
text: ellipse = TRUE draws 95% bivariate normal covariance confidence ellipses (method = "cov") default, small-sample Hotelling’s T2T^2 ellipses (method = "t"). can also add convex hulls (chull = TRUE), group centroids (centroids = TRUE), radial spider segments (spider = TRUE):
code: old_par <- par(mfrow = c(1, 2)) bb_biplot(   p, scale = 0, group = gr, col = "Okabe-Ito",   ellipse = TRUE, ellipse.args = list(method = "cov", level = 0.95, alpha = 0.15),   centroids = TRUE, spider = TRUE,   main = "Covariance Ellipses + Spider" ) bb_biplot(   p, scale = 0, group = gr, col = "Okabe-Ito",   chull = TRUE, ellipse = TRUE,   ellipse.args = list(method = "t", level = 0.90, alpha = 0.12, lwd = 1.5),   main = "Convex Hulls + Hotelling-t" ) par(old_par)

title: Getting Started with betterbiplot
text: Use legend TRUE/"" integer group indices (e.g. legend = c(1, 3) legend = 3) show specific legends. group3 legends automatically condense minimum, middle, maximum symbol sizes:
code: gr3_many <- factor(rep(c(0.5, 1, 2, 2.5, 4, 6, 7), length.out = nrow(iris))) bb_biplot(   p, scale = 0,   group = gr, group2 = gr2, group3 = gr3_many,   legend = c(1, 3),   leg.args = list(title = c("Species", "Weight"), horiz = TRUE, x = -3.2) )

what: 5. Variables, Circle of Equilibrium & Label Placement
title: Getting Started with betterbiplot
text: scale = 0, circle.eq = TRUE draws circle equilibrium contribution, var.args = list(= "circle.eq", lab.offset = 1.08) filters contributing variables nudges labels past arrowheads. Set lab.args = list(rotate = TRUE) radial labels, pos = "auto" (default) deterministic unrotated observation labels:
code: bb_biplot(   p, scale = 0, group = gr, col = "Viridis",   circle.eq = TRUE,   var.args = list(which = "circle.eq", lab.offset = 1.1, col = "firebrick"),   labd = ifelse(seq_len(nrow(iris)) %% 10 == 0, rownames(iris), NA),   lab.args = list(pos = "auto", cex = 0.7),   legend = TRUE, leg.args = list(title = "Species") )

title: Better Looking Biplots in Base R
text: Quickly create beautiful biplots PCA results (prcomp(), princomp(), vegan::rda(), survey::svyprcomp(), FactoMineR::PCA(), ade4::dudi.pca(), psych::principal(), custom matrices). Uses base R - required third-party dependencies. Compatible base biplot() scaling core arguments. Streamlined top-level API grouped styling lists (lab.args, var.args, ellipse.args/chull.args, leg.args, varimax.args) v1.x backwards compatibility. Style points three groups (group3 = "scaled" survey::svyprcomp() weights) colourblind-safe palette shorthands ("Okabe-Ito", "Viridis", etc.). Add selective, condensed, customisable legends. Add statistical covariance Hotelling-t confidence ellipses, convex hulls, group centroids, radial spider lines. Add circle equilibrium contribution. Plays nicely layout(), mfrow(), par(), returns plot coordinates invisibly downstream base R annotations.

title: Better Biplot — bb_biplot
text: Creates customisable biplots Principal Component Analysis (PCA) using base R graphics. Supports stats::prcomp(), stats::princomp(), vegan::rda() (unconstrained PCA), survey::svyprcomp(), FactoMineR::PCA(), ade4::dudi.pca(), psych::principal() objects, well custom score loading matrices.

title: Better Biplot — bb_biplot
code: bb_biplot(x, ...)  # Default S3 method bb_biplot(   x,   y,   xsd,   pc = c(1, 2),   limx,   grid = TRUE,   col,   pch = 21,   cex.pt = 1,   alpha = 0.85,   xlab,   ylab,   axes = TRUE,   cex.axis = 1,   cex = 1,   group,   group2,   group3,   labd,   lab.args = list(),   variables = TRUE,   circle.eq = FALSE,   var.args = list(),   chull = FALSE,   ellipse = FALSE,   centroids = FALSE,   spider = FALSE,   ellipse.args = list(),   legend = FALSE,   leg.args = list(),   f1,   f2,   ... )  # S3 method for class 'prcomp' bb_biplot(   x,   pc = c(1, 2),   scale = 1,   varimax.rotate = FALSE,   varimax.args = list(),   pc.biplot = FALSE,   ... )  # S3 method for class 'princomp' bb_biplot(   x,   pc = c(1, 2),   scale = 1,   varimax.rotate = FALSE,   varimax.args = list(),   pc.biplot = FALSE,   ... )  # S3 method for class 'rda' bb_biplot(   x,   pc = c(1, 2),   scale = 1,   varimax.rotate = FALSE,   varimax.args = list(),   pc.biplot = FALSE,   ... )  # S3 method for class 'svyprcomp' bb_biplot(   x,   pc = c(1, 2),   scale = 1,   varimax.rotate = FALSE,   varimax.args = list(),   pc.biplot = FALSE,   group3,   ... )  # S3 method for class 'PCA' bb_biplot(   x,   pc = c(1, 2),   scale = 1,   varimax.rotate = FALSE,   varimax.args = list(),   pc.biplot = FALSE,   ... )  # S3 method for class 'pca' bb_biplot(   x,   pc = c(1, 2),   scale = 1,   varimax.rotate = FALSE,   varimax.args = list(),   pc.biplot = FALSE,   ... )  # S3 method for class 'principal' bb_biplot(x, pc = c(1, 2), ...)

title: Better Biplot — bb_biplot
text: x Observations matrix least 2 columns, supported PCA object ("prcomp", "princomp", "rda", "svyprcomp", "PCA", "pca", "principal"). ... Additional graphical arguments passed graphics::plot(), plus chull.args (alias ellipse.args) deprecated v1.x arguments. y Variables (loadings/rotation) matrix least 2 columns. Automatically determined supported PCA objects. xsd Optional numeric vector standard deviations variables, used automatic axis variance labels. Automatically determined supported PCA objects. pc Integer vector length 2 giving principal components plot (default c(1, 2)). limx Optional numeric multiplier expand shrink automatic xlim ylim values (e.g., 1.5). grid Logical; draw dashed reference lines origin (default TRUE). col Optional vector colours observations groups, single palette name grDevices::palette.pals() (e.g. "Okabe-Ito") grDevices::hcl.pals() (e.g. "Viridis", "Dark 3"). palette generated automatically omitted. pch Plotting symbol(s) observations (default 21). cex.pt Numeric size multiplier observation points (default 1). alpha Numeric point opacity [0, 1] (default 0.85). xlab Optional x-axis label overriding automatic label. ylab Optional y-axis label overriding automatic label. axes Logical; whether draw axes (default TRUE). cex.axis Numeric size multiplier axes axis labels (default 1). cex Global size multiplier applied plot elements (default 1). group Optional factor (vector coercible factor) length nrow(x) grouping observations colour (symbol multiple pch values supplied without group2). group2 Optional second grouping factor controlling point pch symbols. Requires group. group3 Optional third grouping factor controlling point size. Requires group. group3 legend condensed show minimum, middle, maximum symbol sizes. survey::svyprcomp() objects, can also set "scaled" scale point sizes survey weights (sqrt(w / max(w)), require group displays condensed min/median/max weight legend legends enabled). labd Optional character vector observation labels. Use NA omit individual labels. lab.args Named list label styling options: col: Colour observation labels (default "black"). cex: Numeric size observation labels (default 0.5). font: Font face observation labels (1 = normal, 2 = bold, 3 = italic, 4 = bold italic; default 1). rotate: Logical; rotate observation variable labels radially (default FALSE). ran.adj: Logical; randomly adjust label alignment rotate = TRUE (default FALSE). valign: Vertical alignment rotated variable labels (0, 0.5, 1; default 0.5). pos: Placement unrotated observation labels: "auto" (deterministic radial quadrant, default), "random", integer position(s) 1:4. variables Logical; whether plot variable arrows (default TRUE). circle.eq Logical; draw circle equilibrium contribution scale = 0 (default FALSE). var.args Named list variable-arrow styling options: vname: Optional vector variable names (defaults rownames(y)). : Optional character vector variable names, integer indices, "circle.eq" (requires circle.eq = TRUE scale = 0) subset plotted variables. expand: Numeric multiplier variable arrow lengths (default 1). lab.offset: Numeric multiplier nudging variable labels past arrow tips (default 1.05). arrow.len: Length arrow heads inches; 0 suppresses heads (default 0.15). lwd: Line width variable arrows (default 2). col: Colour variable arrows circle equilibrium (default "#d12631"). col.lab: Colour variable labels (default "black"). cex.lab: Numeric size variable labels (default 1). font.lab: Font face variable labels (default 1). axes: Logical; whether draw top right variable axes (default TRUE). chull Logical; draw convex hulls around group clusters (default FALSE). ellipse Logical; draw ellipses around group clusters (default FALSE). centroids Controls group centroid display group supplied (default FALSE). Accepts FALSE, TRUE (diamond markers + labels), "points" (markers ), "labels" (labels ). spider Logical; draw segments connecting observation group centroid (default FALSE). ellipse.args Named list hull ellipse styling options (also accepted via alias chull.args): method: Ellipse method: "cov" (bivariate normal confidence ellipse, default) "t" (small-sample F / Hotelling's T-squared ellipse). level: Confidence level (0, 1) ellipses (default 0.95). autolim: Logical; automatically expand plot limits ellipses exceed (default TRUE). nofill: Logical; TRUE, draw outlines ellipses convex hulls (default FALSE). alpha: Fill opacity [0, 1] ellipses convex hulls (default 0.25). border.alpha: Border opacity [0, 1] ellipses, convex hulls, spider lines (default 0.9). lwd: Line width ellipses convex hulls (default 2). legend Controls legend display (default FALSE). Accepts FALSE (legend), TRUE "" (legends supplied groups), integer/numeric vector group numbers 1:3 (e.g. 1, c(1, 2), 3) show selected group legends given order. Requires group (except using group3 = "scaled" survey::svyprcomp()). leg.args Named list legend styling options: cex: Numeric size multiplier legends (default 0.75). horiz: Logical; arrange multiple group legends horizontally (default FALSE). x: Optional x-coordinate legend placement. y: Optional y-coordinate legend placement. title: Optional character vector legend title(s). Can match number shown legends positionally, supply titles groups (indexed group number). Defaults "Group", "Group 2", "Group 3" ("Weight" survey::svyprcomp() weights). f1 Optional zero-argument function (name) called plotting points. f2 Optional zero-argument function (name) called plotting variable arrows. scale Numeric scaling exponent 0 1 PCA objects (default 1), matching stats::biplot(). varimax.rotate Logical; TRUE, applies stats::varimax() rotation plotted components supported PCA objects (default FALSE). varimax.args Named list arguments passed stats::varimax() varimax.rotate = TRUE: normalize: Logical; perform Kaiser normalization (default TRUE). eps: Numeric convergence tolerance (default 1e-5). pc.biplot Logical; TRUE, applies additional scaling variables matching stats::biplot() (default FALSE).

title: betterbiplot 2.0.0
text: Added S3 methods additional PCA objects without adding hard dependencies: bb_biplot.rda() unconstrained vegan::rda() PCA models (converted base R scale full compatibility prcomp() / biplot()). bb_biplot.svyprcomp() survey::svyprcomp() objects, supporting group3 = "scaled" scale point sizes survey weights (sqrt(w / max(w))). bb_biplot.PCA() FactoMineR::PCA() objects. bb_biplot.pca() ade4::dudi.pca() objects. bb_biplot.principal() psych::principal() objects. Added selective group legends: legend now accepts TRUE / "" (supplied groups) integer values 1:3 (e.g. 1, c(1, 3), 3) display selected group legends, positional group-indexed title.leg matching. Condensed group3 legends always show minimum, middle, maximum symbol sizes (y.intersp = 1.25), wired survey::svyprcomp(..., group3 = "scaled") also display condensed min/median/max weight legend legends enabled. Streamlined bb_biplot() arguments grouping fine-grained styling lab.args, var.args, ellipse.args (also accepted via alias chull.args), leg.args, combining pc1/pc2 pc = c(1, 2) (keeping title.leg circle.eq top-level). Added soft deprecation shim v1.x flat argument names (pc1, pc2, col.v, whichv, expand, lab_rotation, angle, se, cex.leg, lpx, f1., etc.) existing scripts continue run deprecation warnings. Replaced v1.x parametric ellipse approximation (angle, se) statistical covariance confidence ellipses (ellipse.args = list(method = "cov", level = 0.95), default) small-sample Hotelling’s T-squared ellipses (method = "t"). Added group centroids (centroids = TRUE, "points", "labels") radial spider lines (spider = TRUE). Added var.args = list(lab.offset = 1.05) nudge variable labels past arrow tips. Added palette name shorthand col (grDevices::palette.pals() grDevices::hcl.pals() palette, e.g. col = "Okabe-Ito" "Viridis"). Added configurable point opacity (alpha = 0.85) hull/ellipse opacity (ellipse.args = list(alpha = 0.25, border.alpha = 0.9)). Made unrotated observation label placement deterministic default (lab.args = list(pos = "auto"), also supporting "random" 1:4). bb_biplot() now invisibly returns "bb_biplot" object (scores, loadings, lim, limr, pc, pvar, group_cols, centroids) downstream base R annotations. Added varimax.args (normalize = TRUE, eps = 1e-5) customise stats::varimax() varimax.rotate = TRUE. Added package vignette vignette("betterbiplot") rendered examples across scaling, grouping, overlays, legends, vegan::rda(), survey::svyprcomp(), post-plot extensions.

title: betterbiplot 2.0.0
text: Automatic xlab/ylab generation: Stopped forwarding ... paste0() (caused errors graphical parameters main passed) handled missing/NULL xsd cleanly instead producing empty labels. whichv lab_rotation = TRUE: Subsetted variable rotation angles (lvsrt) alongside y subsetted variable labels receive rotation angles instead first rows’ angles. Explicitly required circle.eq = TRUE instead leaving match unassigned (previously collided base::match). Checked 2D vector radius sqrt((y[, 1] * expand)^2 + (y[, 2] * expand)^2) > cr instead abs(y[, 2]) > cr, keeping whichv = "circle.eq" consistent expand != 1. Single-variable whichv subsetting: Used y[vmatch, , drop = FALSE] preserve 2-column matrix structure cleanly. Rotated observation labels: Fixed adj = c(lsrt[, 2], lsrt[, 3]) (previously passed column 2 twice, ignoring valign ran_adj vertical alignment). f1 f2 callbacks: Replaced .list(args(f1)) list() f1./f2.omitted, fixing crashes calling functions accept ... (graphics::grid()). group2 symbol assignment: Avoided expanding default pch group checking group2, ensuring distinct symbols generated group2 even nlevels(group) >= nlevels(group2). Added length/group validation group2 group3. Single-level group legends: Handled nlevels(group) == 1 computing vertical legend spacing subsequent group2/group3 legends receive NA y-coordinates. Ellipses convex hulls edge cases: Handled unused factor levels constant-x groups cleanly ellipses convex hulls. Label rotation edge cases: Avoided NaN angles (0, 0) applied left-side text justification (ad1 = 1) x < 0 (including negative x-axis y == 0). Modern R checks & namespace hygiene: Replaced class(x) == ... / class(x) != ... .factor() / .character(), avoided shadowing base::c() base::match(), explicitly imported non-base functions (graphics, grDevices, methods, stats).
